method.title: Explore the editing process
method.fullTitle: From harmful tokens to safe responses
method.fullDescription: DELMAN identifies harmful tokens, computes representative key vectors across different contexts, optimizes safe target values, and updates selected MLP down-projection weights.

steps.label: Extract harmful tokens
steps.title: 1. Harmful token extraction
steps.description: An auxiliary language model identifies harmful tokens or phrases in a jailbreak query.

steps.label: Generate contexts
steps.title: 2. Random sequence generation
steps.description: The auxiliary model generates five context sequences containing the identified harmful token. These varied contexts help obtain a more stable key representation.

steps.label: Calculate keys
steps.title: 3. Calculate harmful key representations
steps.description: DELMAN averages the harmful token's MLP activations across generated sequences to obtain a representative key at each selected editing layer.

steps.label: Optimize safe values
steps.title: 4. Optimize values for safe responses
steps.description: DELMAN optimizes a target value to favor a safe refusal, while KL regularization on neutral prompts containing the same token helps preserve benign responses.

steps.label: Update weights
steps.title: 5. Update MLP down-projection weights
steps.description: DELMAN applies a closed-form update to selected MLP down-projection weights, using cached key covariance statistics to help preserve existing associations.
